## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · 2026-11-14T02:13Z

Head-sha: `d8b78d0e8dd4f17663a9cd63000d17e3def06c17`

Reviewed against the pm-dispatch review checklist.

1. **Shape.** Draft PR to `main`, `Fixes #33158`, 5 files, +469/−42 = 511 lines ≤ 3000. `check-governed-merges --pr 33198`: NOT governed (0 of 5 paths hit the register). Changeset `.changeset/33158-suggested-bindings-read-only-installed.md` is a `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell`, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. `installedSuggestions` is a page-local helper; no export, key, i18n string or spec member is added, so no contract review is owed. Every file is inside claim 6868302891. No server or spec change. The seat patched the body (seat-opinion line, signed trailer); `os-tesla` is assigned.
2. **Premise.** It holds, per report 6869548020. A marketplace-installed package is read-only in Studio, and `AccessPillar` mounted `SuggestedBindingsPanel` only under `!packageReadOnly`, so the package that ships an `isDefault` set was exactly the one with no surface to accept it. The marketplace page drew the panel only in the install dialog and the same-session result banner.
3. **Review.**
   - Studio: only the strip's `!packageReadOnly` wrapper is removed; the panel still reads `railPackageId`. Rail "+ New", the matrix and every other edit affordance in the pillar keep their gate, and a CONTROL pins the read-only rail still has no "+ New". Accepting a suggestion is a deployment decision the server already authorizes (`manage_metadata`, anchor gates); no new action path is added.
   - Marketplace: `installedSuggestions` reuses the same panel (its own list read, no second fetcher), only for a package installed here (a loaded local install, or a cloud install into the environment this console renders). It steps aside while the install dialog or a local result banner carries its own panel, so one panel per package is on screen. It is drawn in both the catalog branch and the marketplace-off local branch.
   - `SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx` is unchanged; it already renders nothing on an empty list and on a 403, which the order asked to stay silent, and a pin on each surface holds that (no message, no error toast).
4. **Gates.** 9 new pins across `StudioDesignSurface.accessSuggestionsReadOnly-33158.test.tsx` and `MarketplacePackagePage.installedSuggestions-33158.test.tsx`, over the REAL pillar, page and panel. Two ablations: the gate restored turns 3 of 4 red (writable CONTROL green); the page mount removed turns 4 of 5 red (not-installed CONTROL green). 39 files / 340 tests green across the adjacent suites; app-shell type-check exit 0; 36/36 derived gates exit 0 (`--ran` reconciled). `origin/main` merged once. Check-runs on this head: 40 success, 15 skipped, 0 failure at landing; Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check and all 16 Test UI shards success. `mergeable_state` clean, K = 5.
5. **Accepted deviations.** A run of the whole `views/studio-design/` directory (352 files) was stopped after 20 minutes under the shared lock and narrowed to the adjacent suites; `Test UI` in CI covers the rest. Accepted, since CI runs the full directory before the merge.
6. **Out of scope / landing.**
   - The cloud 成员 page's 「去开通」 link (`TEAM_MEMBER_ACCESS_LINK`) still lands on the Studio landing: dropped — that is the cloud repo's half, out of this repo, and the order put it out of scope.
   - Card acceptance 4, the staging re-read of cloud#3342 item b through the UI: dropped — the QA lane's, after this lands and staging picks it up.
   - Ordinary queue landing: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` now, on the standing landing go-ahead for pm-dispatch-reviewed PRs (maintainer, 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-06). On MERGED: confirm #33158 closed, remove `pm:dispatched`.
